source_facts.fact: Normal SafeBox child CDO overrides bIsNormalSafeBox=true, capacity 4x4, BoxID=920; its four Blueprint parent CDOs and the three selected actor exports contain no password/opening/loot-limit overrides.
source_facts.evidence: packages[].exports; policy_properties_not_serialized lists omissions explicitly; generated class super_name and CDO template_name preserve inheritance provenance

source_facts.fact: Native constructor initializes bIsKeyBox=false, bIsOpened=false, bIsOpening=false, OpeningPlayerId=0, OpenCostSeconds=2.0, PwdDigitsNum=4, bUseRandomSafeBoxPwd=false, SafeBoxPwd=[], RealSafeBoxPwd=[], SafeBoxCodeID=0.

InitSafeBoxPwd authority branch skips random generation when bUseRandomSafeBoxPwd=false and copies SafeBoxPwd into RealSafeBoxPwd; the inherited empty password therefore remains empty after initialization.

The SafeBox also has a separate native InteractorGeneratePasswordComponent. Its child component CDO export18 sets PasswordEveryBodyNum=2; its native constructor sets PasswordNum=3. Empty native SafeBoxPwd does not establish that the complete native box policy is passwordless.
source_facts.evidence: SafeBox package component export18; component constructor 0xba5ce90..0xba5ce9a; separate_generate_password_component

source_facts.fact: The component lifecycle function at vtable slot0x320 validates its owner and requires owner role3, generates numeric VerifyPassword at component+0x108, and calls OnRep_Password. VerifyPwd compares supplied int32 to that field. OnRep_Password broadcasts OnGenPwdComplete with the generated int32 when bound.
source_facts.evidence: 0xba6b30a authority test; 0xba6b317..0xba6b47e generation; 0xba6b40b state write; 0xba6b491 calls 0xbaa2870; 0xbacac00 comparison; 0xbaa28cc..0xbaa28e2 delegate

source_facts.fact: CheckIfNeedVerifySafeBoxCode returns true only when RealSafeBoxPwd.Num == PwdDigitsNum and PwdDigitsNum > 0; the normal empty baseline returns false.

CanOpenThisBox normal branch admits a closed box only when OpeningPlayerId==0. This predicate is a mutable box-state check; admission, current actor binding and accepted movement range remain independent server conditions.
source_facts.evidence: 0xc1a94c0..0xc1a9535; this is not an unconditional permission oracle

source_facts.evidence: native functions OpenThisBoxInner and OnIsOpenedReplicate; saved class replication layout pin has bIsOpened field 116 at native offset 0x2492

source_facts.fact: LootLimit baseline 0 denotes Both; OnlySource=1, OnlyTarget=2, None=3. This is a transfer-direction enum, not password or lock state.

HasSearchedByPlayer returns true immediately for IsInContainer=false. The existing explicit instant-search local seed uses this native state; timed per-player search would require IsInContainer=true and qualified SearchedPlayers updates.

integration_design.policy_authority: Persist a per-room per-actor box state seeded once from these defaults, with source contract hash and actor binding; retain finite contents and revision across reloads.
authorization_inputs: accepted movement position and source-qualified range
registered per-box state and selected action tag
integration_design.normal_open: Require an explicit locally selected unlock rule recorded in durable policy identity. The native normal box has a separate generated VerifyPassword component, so native SafeBoxPwd=[] must not silently mean fully passwordless. Atomically claim a closed unowned box, evaluate the local rule and finite opening/search timing, commit opened state, then publish native bIsOpened field 116. An already opened box may be browsed without reseeding or rerunning CanOpenThisBox.
integration_design.transfer: Keep finite contents in the same transaction domain as player inventory; reject direction forbidden by LootLimit; require current box access and distance; replay identifiers must preserve quantities.
integration_design.terminal: Do not require terminal authority to construct or use normal box dispatch. Terminal operations must reject when a dedicated terminal authority is absent.
tests: missing local unlock rule rejects initialization
closed unowned box opens only after selected local unlock rule
second opener cannot claim owned box
all four transfer directions follow enum
reload preserves opened state and remaining contents and local rule identity
normal open works with no terminal authority
terminal operation rejects with no terminal authority

limitations: Static cooked/default and saved native-code evidence; no new live interaction was performed.
Normal branches are qualified; hotfix dispatcher branches are not execution proof.
Baseline omission does not prove absence of later runtime mutation; local authority owns and validates such mutations.
No bHasOpened transition or terminal/extraction policy is inferred here.

Separate component VerifyPassword generation and verification are qualified; the complete native UI/RPC path requiring its result has not been traced. Any local simplified unlock rule must be explicit and may not be represented as original native passwordless policy.
Actor SavePos is not accepted as an actual world position in this contract.
